item.title: Danantara Governance Test, Indonesia-Germany Energy Pact, OpenAI Safety Pivot
item.description: Three converging pressures—SOE restructuring credibility, a €3 bn energy transition commitment, and OpenAI's self-imposed model-pacing safeguards—demand fresh analytical frameworks this week.
